chunks: Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Yaqṭīnī from Ubayd Allah al-Dihqān from Durust from Abd Allah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual or physical consequence of overeating according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links the physical ailment of leprosy (*al-baras*) to the ethical failing of overeating, reflecting the Shia tradition of viewing bodily diseases as manifestations of spiritual or behavioral excess. This teaching underscores the holistic Islamic view where dietary discipline is not merely for health but for moral purification, a concept deeply rooted in the Prophetic tradition of moderation.
